subject: SCIM sync timeline & owner action items for Brightwell Health
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@brightwell.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: Brightwell Security <security@brightwell.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCIM sync timeline & owner action items

Hi Irene,

We're starting our SOC 2 readiness sprint and need a short package from Redwood around your SCIM provisioning behavior so we can map it into our evidence binder. Specific asks from our security team: 

- A CSV of current SCIM attribute-to-role owner mappings (who owns each attribute/role in our tenant).
- A small delta sample showing a create, update, and deprovision event with timestamps (we want to validate incremental sync semantics).
- Confirmation on deprovision timing SLA (how quickly do you propagate deprovision events via SCIM / best-effort latency).
- Any notes on how you represent suspended accounts vs deleted accounts in SCIM.

Can you confirm if you can deliver the roster + delta sample by next Wednesday (2025-03-18)? If not, please propose a date. Also let us know if you prefer a brief call to walk through the mapping.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Senior InfoSec Manager | Brightwell Health
[Attachment: scim_requirements_questions.pdf (PDF)]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@brightwell.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM sync timeline & owner action items

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. We can provide what you need and I outlined a proposed timeline and deliverables below. I copied our provisioning and platform leads so we can extract a representative delta sample.

Proposed deliverables (target delivery: 2025-03-18):
- scim_owner_roster.csv — per-attribute owner and role mapping (CSV).
- scim_delta_sample.log — minimal create, update, deprovision events with timestamps and request IDs.
- redwood_scim_mapping_v1.pdf — brief mapping notes (how we represent suspended vs deleted).

A couple clarifying points:
- Deprovision SLA: for customer-initiated SCIM provisioning via our hosted connector we typically emit a provisioning event to your IdP immediately; propagation to downstream systems depends on your SCIM consumer. For telemetry inside Redwood (what we log), deprovision actions are recorded within 1-2 minutes and visible in our audit trail within 5 minutes. We'll call this out explicitly in the mapping doc.
- Suspension vs deletion: we represent suspension as a change of active=false with a suspension_reason attribute; deletion is represented as a remove operation (DELETE) in the SCIM payload. The PDF spells the exact attribute names we send.

Next steps / owner matrix:
- jonas.weber: extract delta sample (jonas, can you pull a small window with a create/update/delete example and redact PII where required?)
- marcus.lin: generate the owner roster export and validate role mapping against our RBAC service
- I'll assemble the mapping PDF and sign off on the text for your binder.

If you want a 20-minute walkthrough after we drop the files I can schedule something with you and our platform lead.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_scim_mapping_v1.pdf (PDF)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@brightwell.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM sync timeline & owner action items

Hi Maria — attaching the files we discussed. Short answers first, then deliverables below.

Answers:
- Deprovision timing: Redwood records a deprovision event in our audit logs within 1-2 minutes and the event is visible in our internal auditing UI within 5 minutes. We send a SCIM DELETE for the resource in the same cycle; downstream consumer processing latency is outside of Redwood's control.
- Suspension vs deletion: suspension is active=false + suspension_reason attribute; deletion is a SCIM DELETE. We include both in the mapping doc.

Deliverables attached:
- scim_owner_roster.csv — columns: role_name, attribute, role_owner_email, owner_type, justification. (redacted where owner is a service account).
- scim_delta_sample.log — redacted create/update/delete events with timestamps and placeholder UUIDs.
- redwood_scim_mapping_v1.pdf — concise mapping and notes on attribute naming and recommended filter rules.

Action items:
- Maria: confirm receipt and whether you want a 20-minute walkthrough (I can propose 03/20 or 03/21 US-PST).
- Brightwell Security: please flag any attribute names you want renamed in the mapping (we can support aliases on your tenant).

If you need a signed attestation or an expanded sample window for audit purposes, let us know and we'll route through Legal/Compliance for an formal statement.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: scim_owner_roster.csv (CSV), scim_delta_sample.log (LOG), redwood_scim_mapping_v1.pdf (PDF)]
